_about: Verdicts of data/influence_review.json whose sentence is no longer in the records and that tools/rekey_influence_review.py could not pair with a current sentence with confidence. Each keeps its verdict, the sentence as reviewed ("was") and the closest current sentence for the same record and funder ("closest", with how alike the two are). A kept one is still shown in assets/influence.json with its old sentence. To settle one: set "move_to" to the cid of a current candidate, or "remove": true, then run python3 -I tools/rekey_influence_review.py --write and python3 -I tools/build_influence.py.
